name: notambourine
description: Claude Code plugins for the NoTambourine consulting practice.

plugins.name: nt-brand
plugins.description: Defines NoTambourine's brand system, including tokens, components, fonts, voice, and copy auditing.

plugins.name: nt-dev
plugins.description: Standardizes everyday development work and house conventions. Never posts end-of-day updates; hooks guide GitHub usage and identify Unicode dash violations.

plugins.name: nt-pm
plugins.description: Creates plain-English status updates for non-technical audiences from repository and team activity. Never posts or deploys.

plugins.name: nt-voice
plugins.description: Applies the appropriate prose voice pass for humanization and editorial requests. Requires nt-vendor.

plugins.name: nt-seo-spider
plugins.description: Connects to Screaming Frog SEO Spider for crawl analysis. Requires SEO Spider 24+ with MCP running; disabled by default because it provides 29 tools.

plugins.name: nt-vendor
plugins.description: Mirrors third-party skills from upstream repositories so other plugins can use them. The nt-vendor prefix identifies external work.

plugins.name: wormhook
plugins.description: Blocks npm/PyPI supply-chain malware and agent-hijack persistence at the Claude Code hook — before it can run.

plugins.name: qrspi
plugins.description: GitHub-native structured feature development: Query, Research, Spec, Plan, Implement.

plugins.name: nt-share
plugins.description: Share a file, folder, or screenshot as one branded, unguessable link on share.notambourine.com. Browsers get a rendered page, curl and Slack unfurls get raw bytes from the same URL. Needs a NoTambourine-issued token.
